name: Diluted Test Order for WooCommerce
author: Diluted

sections.description:
Diluted Test Order for WooCommerce adds a “Test order” payment method to WooCommerce. Use it to verify checkout, thank-you page, order emails and order status without going through a real payment gateway.

  • Admin-only – Only users who can manage WooCommerce (e.g. administrators or shop managers) see the method at checkout.
  • Orders placed with this method are marked as paid immediately. The normal post-payment flow runs (customer emails, stock reduction, etc.).

Requires WooCommerce 6.0+. Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the block-based checkout.

Usage

Log in as an administrator or shop manager, add a product to the cart, go to checkout. Select “Test order (fake payment)” and place the order. The order completes and you are redirected to the thank-you page.

Order details

  • Payment method in admin: “Test order (admin only)” or the title you set in settings.
  • Transaction ID on the order: diluted_test_order_{order_id} (so you can identify test orders).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/diluted-test-order-for-woocommerce/ or install via WordPress admin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments and enable “Test order (admin only)”.
sections.faq:
Who can see the test order payment method?

Only users with the “manage_woocommerce” capability (typically administrators and shop managers).

Is this compatible with block checkout and HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce custom order tables (HPOS) and the cart/checkout blocks.
